label: No QC diagnostic
definition: No per-shot QC screening; all footprints assigned to polygons by spatial join were retained before the 60 m internal buffer.

label: Baseline QC: L2B quality=1/degrade=0 and L4A quality=1/degrade=0
definition: Baseline QC retaining L2B and L4A observations with quality_flag = 1 and degrade_flag = 0.

label: Baseline + low AGBD uncertainty
definition: Baseline QC plus retention of the lowest-uncertainty AGBD observations, retaining the best 90% when uncertainty fields are available.

label: Baseline + night-only
definition: Baseline QC plus nighttime acquisitions only, using solar_elevation <= 0 for both L2B and L4A.

label: Baseline + sensitivity_2b >= 0.8 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.8
definition: Baseline QC plus sensitivity_2b >= 0.80 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.80.

label: Baseline + sensitivity_2b >= 0.9 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.9
definition: Baseline QC plus sensitivity_2b >= 0.90 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.90.

label: Baseline + sensitivity_2b >= 0.95 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.95
definition: Baseline QC plus sensitivity_2b >= 0.95 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.95.

label: Baseline + sensitivity_2b >= 0.99 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.99
definition: Baseline QC plus sensitivity_2b >= 0.99 and sensitivity_4a >= 0.99.

label: Baseline + strong beams only
definition: Baseline QC plus restriction to strong/high-energy beams using data-driven per-beam sensitivity statistics.
